## Summary / Resumen
What changes and why? Related issue:

## Validation / Pruebas
List commands and actual results; identify skipped or failing checks. Include desktop/mobile screenshots for visual changes.

- [ ] Scope is limited and existing functionality is preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, private inputs, unapproved media or model weights.
- [ ] Exact locks, dependency licenses and distribution notices reviewed.
- [ ] Security, build, accessibility, responsive and SEO gates passed or limitations documented.
- [ ] Preview remains noindex and no deployment is implied.
- [ ] Documentation and tests updated.

## Risks and review
Describe compatibility, performance, accessibility and remaining risks. Do not merge your own unreviewed changes or bypass required checks.
